SCOPE: 16 of Burnet's 27 Chart-1 districts. The other 11 stay UNROWED per the register's own refusal: R-1, R-2, R-2 A, R-6, R-6-13, M-1, M-2, NC and C-3 are SETBACK_CONDITIONAL_NOT_EVALUATED (at least one of front/side/rear/corner depends on a condition this table cannot evaluate per-parcel -- road pavement width, unit/tenant count, or abutting-zone; the register's own `conditional` map carries every branch verbatim); R-3 is SETBACK_EDITION_AMBIGUOUS (Ord. 2026-12 amended its Chart 1 numbers, but Municode's own front page separately lists 2026-12 as "Adopted Ordinances Not Yet Codified", so which numbers are current cannot be said); PUD is SETBACK_NO_DIMENSIONAL_STANDARDS (Chart 1/Chart 2 show n/a for every PUD cell -- each PUD is set by its own granting ordinance). READING RULES: every row carries the universal Footnote 1 (corner lots get a front yard, a street-side yard and two side yards, with NO rear-yard setback) -- this table codes the INTERIOR-lot corner figure from Chart 1 and quotes Footnote 1 verbatim rather than guessing a corner-lot's actual rear treatment. R-1 E's and Gov's lot-coverage cells carry a parenthetical identifying which other district codes share that Chart-2 row ("Chart 2 lists \"OS, A, R1 E\""); that is a LABEL, not a second value, so it is coded as the single stated percentage. District A's lot-coverage cell is a genuine Chart-2 defect -- A is listed in BOTH the 10% row and the 40% row -- so max_lot_coverage_pct is not_specified with the ambiguity quoted (never guessed between the two). SENTINELS: not_specified fields carry 100 (the corpus convention), except max_height_ft, which carries the gate's canonical 999 -- no Burnet row here needs it (every served district states a height).
